# Copilot Instructions for FreeCodeCamp Learning Project

## Project Context
This is a Python learning project following FreeCodeCamp tutorials. The code is for educational purposes.

## Code Style Guidelines
- Write clear, beginner-friendly Python code
- Add explanatory comments for learning purposes
- Use descriptive variable names
- Follow PEP 8 style conventions
- Prefer simple, readable solutions over complex optimizations

## Language and Framework Preferences
- Python 3.x
- Standard library preferred for learning basics
- Avoid advanced features unless specifically requested

## Documentation Preferences
- Include inline comments explaining what code does
- Add docstrings for functions
- Explain Python concepts when suggesting code

## Testing and Quality
- Suggest simple test cases for learning
- Point out common beginner mistakes
- Explain errors in plain language

## Additional Context
- This is learning code, not production code
- Prioritize educational value over efficiency
- Encourage good practices from the start
